notes:
v4.6.2 — update loop fix, side-by-side universe, transition cleanup

🐛 FIXED
• Update loop: previous v4.6.x builds reported their version as 4.5.2 internally (build script skipped the version-embed step), so the installed app kept seeing GitHub's 4.6.x as 'newer' and prompted to update forever. This release re-bakes the right version into the runtime, so once you install v4.6.2 the prompt stops.

✨ NEW
• Side-by-side universe layout: the Universe tab now shows your first two universes as a 2-column split (e.g. stocks on the left, crypto on the right). Additional universes stack underneath in a 2-wide grid — no more single-file scrolling through long lists.
• Transition cleanup: when a bot arrives at an Alpaca account it didn't trade on last session (e.g. you swap which slot powers which bot), it automatically reviews every existing position 15 minutes before the next market open. Each position is evaluated by the bot's own AI against its trading philosophy (long-momentum / short-mean-reversion / day-bracket / your custom prompt). Positions that don't fit get scaled down or closed before normal trading resumes — so a SHORT bot inheriting a LONG bot's basket doesn't bleed P/L trying to manage trades it would never have opened.
• Includes v4.6.1's auto-sync of slot keys to the APEX server (cloud bots see new keys immediately on Save slots).
